g.text: OpenSearch / Elasticsearch (Full Inverted Index)

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: High query flexibility at massive storage and RAM cost

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: 1. Lucene Tokenizer & Analyzer

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Tokenizes EVERY word in message body into discrete terms:

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: ['level', 'error', 'app', 'payment', 'msg', 'db', 'timeout']

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Builds memory-intensive term dictionaries

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: 2. Inverted Index Dictionary

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Maps every single token to posting lists of document IDs

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Enormous RAM and fast NVMe SSD storage footprint

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Index size frequently exceeds 120% of the raw log data!

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Expensive write amplification during large ingest bursts

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Grafana Loki (Index-Free Chunk Store)

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Cost-effective object storage with Prometheus-like labels

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: 1. Metadata Label Extraction

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Indexes ONLY high-level stream labels (app='payment', env='prod')

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Ignores log message contents entirely during indexing

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Zero tokenization overhead; minimal RAM footprint

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: 2. Snappy/Gzip Compressed Chunk Store

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Compresses raw log lines into 2MB chunks (Snappy/gzip)

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Flushes chunks directly to cheap cloud object storage (S3/GCS)

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Storage cost is ~90% lower than Elasticsearch

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Queries scan matching stream chunks using LogQL grep
